notes: The universe remains degenerate in the ways integration round 2 recorded, and w107 closes none of them. Two measured findings worth reading beside this gate. First, the v1 rectangle cannot make food: of the 59 authored resource-yield effects at target universe, exactly five sit in a v1 cell and all five route to stone, because terram is the only material-bearing form among the twelve. Every ruleset comparison taken inside the v1 rectangle is therefore an argument about stone. Second, stated carefully because the sloppy version has misled several readers: advanceConstruction and applyLibraryUpkeep both have production callers in world-step.ts and run every tick, so construction is NOT inert. What is measured over 1200 ticks of the reference universe with zero god actions is constructionStoneOwed 0, buildProgressAdded 0, universitiesCompleted 0, against exactly one university -- the seeded academy, already complete. Founding a site is a god action, so with no actions submitted there is nothing to advance and stone is never spent. Those two facts together are why the campaign-plan W90 measurement of a yield-maximising ruleset was null by construction of its arms rather than for want of a mechanism: the arms could only make stone, and stone had nothing to buy.

rationale: PR #161 (anti-requisites) ships one symmetric exclusion pair in packages/content/data/cell.json: creo-ignem EXCLUDES creo-umbra and back, both halves carrying the same reason and resolution "destructive". Recorded from the tree MERGED WITH origin/main be446a6 (PR #125, w108/university-fidelity), not from the branch alone, per the w77 precedent that a competing baseline re-record means taking the measurement from the merged tree. THIS FILE IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BALANCE CLAIM: release-plan.md forbids a balance claim before 0.5.0, and nothing here is one. BYTE-IDENTITY IS ESTABLISHED BY GREPPING FOR NON-ZERO DELTAS, NOT BY READING THE PASS COLUMN -- a row can pass three standard errors while moving a great deal, and this gate has a live example: referenceGrimoires@permissive-breadth moves +19.6 and PASSES at 1.27 SE. NO GOLDEN FIXTURE WAS REGENERATED. balance-gate-ascension-v1 is deliberately NOT re-recorded: it carries a superseded rngRegistryHash from PR #72, already fails on main for that older and unrelated reason, and balance/README.md marks its job not required to merge, so re-recording it is a separate decision on a separate failure -- the same carve-out the w70/opening-square notes record. THIS FILE (the twenty-year gate, worldTickCap 240, 200 runs, 10 metrics): all 10 rows moved against the superseded baseline, every one inside tolerance. ATTRIBUTION, MEASURED RATHER THAN ARGUED. #125 changed no content file, so provenance.contentHash did not move for it and this gate PASSED against the superseded baseline before regeneration; what moved are values, and they are #125 re-rolling handle-keyed draws by allocating UNIVERSITY_STAFF link rows (contracts.md 6 splits the RNG per entity handle), which is the same mechanism #125 own rationale describes for the denial-warden arm lines. The exclusion pair contributes EXACTLY ZERO here, and that was tested rather than asserted: stripping the excludes arrays from the two cells, rebuilding, and re-running this sweep reproduces every current value BYTE-IDENTICALLY. The structural reason is that both halves of the pair are creo and this sweep plays the v1 rectangle (intellego, perdo, rego x mentem, terram, limen, nomen), so the reference universe cannot reach either cell. NOTE THE CORRECTION THIS FORCES TO AN EARLIER CLAIM: on the pre-merge branch both reference gates were byte-identical at every row, and that is no longer true on the merged tree. The pair is still invisible to them; #125 is not. HORIZON CORRECTION: docs/design/anti-requisites.md labelled this gate "2400 world ticks". The committed sweep sets worldTickCap 240; 2400 is the horizon of the two-hundred-year ascension gate. Recorded as a second, independent correction rather than as one mechanism: the tidy "every label shifted one rung up the ladder" story does not survive the ladder itself, which is 60 / 240 / 240 / 2400, and puts this error two rungs up while the error on the five-year gate is one rung. The doc is corrected in the same commit.
